title: The Late Letter
author: W. M. Pemberton
blurb: Ivo Amberdale, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
